hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,sys,os,subprocess; d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read() or "{}"); f=(d.get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or ""; sys.exit(0) if not (f.endswith(".md") and os.path.abspath(f).startswith(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]))) else None; r=subprocess.run(["python3",os.path.join(sys.argv[1],"System","brain.command"),"lint",f],capture_output=True,text=True); print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"brain.command lint flagged "+f+": "+(r.stdout or "")+(r.stderr or "")}})) if r.returncode!=0 else None' "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || true

python3 -c 'import json,sys; from pathlib import Path; b=Path(sys.argv[1]); skip={".git",".trash",".obsidian",".claude",".backups"}; mani=b/"System"/"Data"/"manifest.json"; newest=max((p.stat().st_mtime for p in b.rglob("*.md") if not (set(p.relative_to(b).parts) & skip)), default=0.0); mt=(mani.stat().st_mtime if mani.exists() else 0.0); print(json.dumps({"systemMessage":"BRAIN reminder: vault .md files changed since the last index build. Run python3 System/brain.command health and update Memory before finishing. If anything went wrong this session (a correction, a missed step, a skill mis-fire, an ambiguous rule), capture it with python3 System/brain.command friction so the reflection loop can learn from it."})) if newest>mt+1 else None' "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || true
